604:t_1:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「...I've been thinking all this time about why that numbskull... $$カルロス$$ wanted to change the world...」

604:t_1:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「He wanted to destroy the world that $$クロノ$$ controlled, didn't he?」

604:t_1:6.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「...Just before he graduated from college, I told him about $$クロノ$$, the watchers of humanity's evolution, and the $$アクシオン$$ family's destiny as its $$キング$$.」

604:t_1:7.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「He said he would do as he pleased until that day came. He made $$アクシオン$$ a foundation and built it into the world's foremost corporate group.」

604:t_1:8.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「So he could fight me... and $$クロノ$$.」

604:t_1:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「That was why $$エルガン・ローディック$$ entrusted him with the $$揺れる天秤$$ $$スフィア$$, wasn't it?」

604:t_1:10.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「...What do you intend to do now?」

604:t_1:12.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「I already have virtually no real authority. More fundamentally, one could say $$クロノ$$ itself is meaningless in the world as it is now.」

604:t_1:13.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「Even if you learn who its members are now, there is nothing you can do.」

604:t_1:14.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'm well aware of that.」

604:t_1:15.en:
$$トライア$$
「But I don't believe there's nothing left to do.」

604:t_1:16.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「Do you mean to carry on my son's aspirations?」

604:t_1:17.en:
$$トライア$$
「I owe him no such obligation.」

604:t_1:18.en:
$$トライア$$
「But in the end, we're heading toward the same goal he was.」

604:t_1:19.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「Once the $$宇宙世紀$$'s $$ラプラスの箱$$ is opened, $$クロノ$$'s doctrine will inevitably come to light too.」

604:t_1:20.en:
$$トライア$$
「Whatever it is, we won't stop. Neither $c nor I...」

604:t_1:23.en:
$$トライア$$
「I have no intention of listening to anything you say.」

604:t_1:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Shall we get going, $$トライア$$? Everyone is here.」

604:t_1:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I asked him to accompany us, but he refused. It seems he intends to go into space alone.」

604:t_1:27.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's fine. Then let's go.」

604:t_1:29.en:
$$トライア$$
「Goodbye, emperor with no clothes. You old man the times have left behind, enjoy your remaining years in some forgotten corner of the world.」

604:t_1:30.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「...An old man the times have left behind... is that what I am...?」

604:t_1:32.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「Was it you who told them of the $$キング$$'s existence, $$グエン・サード・ラインフォード$$?」

604:t_1:33.en:
$$グエン$$
「From your tone, it seems you also know I was helping the forces opposing the Empire.」

604:t_1:35.en:
$$グエン$$
「But the answer to your earlier question is no. All I did was tell them you were here.」

604:t_1:37.en:
$$グエン$$
「Will you purge me as a traitor?」

604:t_1:38.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「...This old man no longer has the energy for that.」

604:t_1:39.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「Perhaps, ever since the day I lost my son, some part of me has been waiting for this day...」

604:t_1:40.en:
$$グエン$$
「Is that why you welcomed me into $$クロノ$$ too?」

604:t_1:41.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「I took a chance on the youth... the ambition I saw in you.」

604:t_1:42.en:
$$グエン$$
「You give me too much credit. I have nothing of my own. I'm a man who merely uses other people's power.」

604:t_1:43.en:
$$グエン$$
「If I have helped bring this day about, it must be because I had the strength to believe.」

604:t_1:44.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「The despairing future described in the final chapter of 《$$メトロポリス$$》... Do you mean believing that something lies beyond it?」

604:t_1:45.en:
$$グエン$$
「No... I mean the strength to believe in $$ローラ$$ and his companions, $c.」

604:t_1:48.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「Time is beginning to move... Time that stood still ever since that day, the day humanity set foot on the Moon...」

604:t_1:49.en:
$$アクシオン$$
「For humanity, this is the beginning of the true battle...」

604:t_1:53.en: ～$$シャイアン基地$$ Underground　$$コロニーレーザー$$ Control Room～

604:t_1:55.en:
$$ローナン$$
「The $$コロニーレーザー$$ is ready to fire. All that remains is to authorize it.」

604:t_1:56.en:
$$マーサ$$
「$c will dispose of $$ネオ・ジオン$$, and we will dispose of $c...」

604:t_1:57.en:
$$ローナン$$
「And $$サイアム・ビスト$$, who knows the deeper truth hidden at the heart of $$ラプラスの箱$$, will die too...」

604:t_1:58.en:
$$ローナン$$
「This will preserve $$クロノ$$'s doctrine. Humanity on Earth will be safe as well.」

604:t_1:59.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Humanity on Earth? Don't you mean the chosen few?」

604:t_1:60.en:
$$ローナン$$
「...I won't deny it. But that is the limit of humanity as a species.」

604:t_1:61.en:
$$マーサ$$
「The many, so the few may live... The reverse of what $$カーディアス・ビスト$$ always used to say.」

604:t_1:63.en:
$$マーサ$$
「It can't be helped. The times have forced us to do this.」

604:t_1:64.en:
$$ローナン$$
「Then I authorize the firing of the $$コロニーレーザー$$.」

604:t_1:65.en:
$$マーサ$$
「In a few minutes, $c will vanish along with $$メガラニカ$$.」

604:t_1:66.en:
$$ローナン$$
「The Box's secret... $$クロノ$$'s doctrine will be preserved.」

604:t_1:68.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Whatever you say, it's no use, $$アルベルト$$. The $$コロニーレーザー$$ has been authorized to fire... We can no longer stop it.」

604:t_1:69.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Aunt $$マーサ$$! How could you...?!」

604:t_1:70.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「You're forcing people into submission! Isn't that the very logic men use?!」

604:t_1:72.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「You've spent your life condemning men's logic...! And this is how you act in the end?!」

604:t_1:73.en:
$$ローナン$$
「Let go, $$アルベルト$$. What right do you have to do this?」

604:t_1:74.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ is there!」

604:t_1:76.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「I felt it clearly! Your son... $$リディ・マーセナス$$ is at $$インダストリアル７$$!!」

604:t_1:78.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「He's the $$バンシィ$$'s pilot!!」

604:t_1:79.en:
$$ローナン$$
「Why, $$リディ$$...?! Why... are you there...?!」

604:t_2:3.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...I am a descendant of the $$ザビ家$$, which led the $$ジオン公国$$ that once existed in $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$宇宙世紀$$ world.」

604:t_2:4.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「However, what I am about to tell you has no connection to my ancestry.」

604:t_2:5.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I have learned a secret concerning the very foundation of the $$連邦政府$$. It is not a matter that concerns only the $$宇宙世紀$$ world.」

604:t_2:6.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「As one person living in this world, I intend to share that secret with all of you.」

604:t_2:7.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「The beginning of the $$宇宙世紀$$... marked the start of an era in which humanity made space its home.」

604:t_2:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「The $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter issued by the $$地球連邦$$ government of that time was the foundation of the government... and the cornerstone of its policies.」
